# Data dictionary (Artifact A)

Every table and column HIMS stores, generated from the code (spec 28.1 items 2, 3, 4 and 7). Read [README.md](README.md) first for the classification, lifecycle and access rules. Each hospital deployment has its own database with these tables (ADR-003).

## Sensitivity levels

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Secret** | Credentials and keys. Stored only hashed or encrypted; never shown, exported or logged. |
| **Restricted** | Personal data or security records: names, contact details, registration numbers, documents, IP addresses, audit content. Need-to-know access by permission; kept out of logs, traces and URLs. |
| **Internal** | Hospital configuration and system data. Visible to staff with the right permission. |
| **Clinical** | Patient health information (PHI), from Phase 2: minimum necessary, every read audited, never in logs, traces, URLs or emails (P0 part 02). |

**Set by:** *System* = HIMS fills it in; *Person* = entered on a screen, in the admin console or through the API (always checked by the services); *System (who did it)* = the signed-in person who made the change.

Common to most tables: `id` is a random UUID (never a sequence), business numbers (employee number, MRN…) are separate columns, times are stored in UTC (`timestamp with time zone`), dates without time stay dates, foreign keys are indexed automatically, and `version` protects edits made at the same time (a stale save is refused with 409).

## Hospital (organization)

**Owner (source of truth):** Organization/facility domain. **Design:** [ADR-009-single-organization-per-deployment](../../decisions/ADR-009-single-organization-per-deployment.md).

<a id="organizations"></a>
### `organizations`

The hospital organization served by this dedicated deployment (ADR-003, ADR-009).

- **Model:** `organizations.Organization`
- **Lifecycle:** One row per deployment. Never deleted; details edited with a version check.
- **Rules:** `organizations_one_per_deployment`: Unique: singleton; `organizations_singleton_true`: Check: singleton = True

## Patients (master patient record)

**Owner (source of truth):** Patient domain: front desk and medical records (HIMS-PAT-001). **Design:** [02-database-design](../../p0/phase-2-patients/02-database-design.md), [patients](patients.md).

<a id="patients"></a>
### `patients`

One person who is, or was, a patient of the hospital: one MRN in every facility.

- **Model:** `patients.Patient`
- **Lifecycle:** Never deleted (D24; retention set by legal before go-live). Corrections are versioned and audited before/after; an old name is kept as an alias. A merged record stays, read-only (HIMS-PAT-004).
- **Rules:** `patients_mrn_unique`: Unique: organization, mrn; `patients_merged_has_target`: Check: (NOT status = 'merged' OR merged_into is set); `patients_not_merged_into_self`: Check: (merged_into is empty OR NOT merged_into = id)
- **Extra indexes:** `patients_dob_idx`: date_of_birth; `patients_facility_idx`: registered_facility, -created_at

One service, repair or calibration visit. Append-only (database trigger): a mistake is corrected by adding another record, so the history can be trusted in an inspection.

## Numbering (MRN, visit, invoice, claim numbers)

**Owner (source of truth):** Organization/facility domain. **Design:** [numbering-schemes](numbering-schemes.md).

<a id="numbering_schemes"></a>
### `numbering_schemes`

How one kind of number is built. One per document type, either for the whole hospital (``facility`` empty) or for one facility (overrides the hospital-wide scheme there).

- **Model:** `numbering.NumberingScheme`
- **Lifecycle:** Never deleted; switched off. Edits versioned and audited.
- **Rules:** `numbering_scheme_unique`: Unique: document_type, facility (empty values count as equal); `numbering_padding_range`: Check: (padding ≥ 3 AND padding ≤ 12); `numbering_fy_month_range`: Check: (financial_year_start_month ≥ 1 AND financial_year_start_month ≤ 12); `numbering_mrn_hospital_wide`: Check: (NOT document_type = 'mrn' OR facility is empty)

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | uuid | no | uuid4() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now (on create) | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row was created (UTC) |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now (on every save) | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row last changed (UTC) |
| `version` | integer | no | `1` | 0 or more | System | Internal: System metadata | Edit counter: a save based on an older version is refused (409) |
| `organization_id` | uuid → organizations.id | no | — | on delete PROTECT | System | Internal: Reference | The hospital that owns the row (one per deployment) |
| `document_type` | varchar(16) | no | — | `mrn` (Patient record number (MRN)), `encounter` (Encounter / visit number), `invoice` (Invoice number), `claim` (Insurance claim number) | Person | Internal: Business data | Document type |
| `facility_id` | uuid → facilities.id | yes | — | on delete PROTECT | Person | Internal: Reference | Leave empty for the whole hospital. Set to give one facility its own series. |
| `prefix` | varchar(10) | no | — | up to 10 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Prefix |
| `separator` | varchar(1) | no | `NumberingScheme.Separator.DASH` | `-` (Dash (-)), `/` (Slash (/)), `` (None) | Person | Internal: Business data | Separator |
| `include_facility_code` | boolean | no | `False` | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Put the facility code in the number, e.g. ENC-BLR-2026-0001. |
| `period` | varchar(16) | no | `NumberingScheme.Period.NONE` | `none` (Never restarts), `calendar_year` (Restarts every calendar year), `financial_year` (Restarts every financial year), `month` (Restarts every month) | Person | Internal: Business data | Period |
| `year_format` | varchar(5) | no | `NumberingScheme.YearFormat.FULL` | `full` (Full (2026, 2026-27)), `short` (Short (26, 26-27)) | Person | Internal: Business data | Year format |
| `financial_year_start_month` | smallint | no | `4` | — | Person | Internal: Business data | India: 4 (April). US: usually 1 (January) or the hospital's own. |
| `padding` | smallint | no | `6` | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Digits in the running number, e.g. 6 gives 000001. |
| `start_at` | integer | no | `1` | 0 or more | System | Internal: Business data | First running number of each new series. |
| `is_active` | boolean | no | `True` | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Switched on (true) or off (false); rows are switched off, not deleted |

<a id="numbering_counters"></a>
### `numbering_counters`

The last running number used, per scheme and period. Locked with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in the transaction that creates the record, so a rolled-back record also gives its number back (no gaps, which GST invoice series need) and two requests never get the same number.

- **Model:** `numbering.NumberCounter`
- **Lifecycle:** One per scheme and period; the value only increases.
- **Rules:** `numbering_counter_unique`: Unique: scheme, period_key

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | bigint | no | — | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `scheme_id` | uuid → numbering_schemes.id | no | — | on delete PROTECT | Person | Internal: Reference | Scheme |
| `period_key` | varchar(16) | no | — | up to 16 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Period key |
| `last_value` | bigint | no | `0` | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Last value |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now (on every save) | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row last changed (UTC) |

<a id="issued_numbers"></a>

Register of every number handed out. Append-only; the database refuses duplicates.

- **Model:** `numbering.IssuedNumber`
- **Lifecycle:** Append-only register; a number is never reused.
- **Rules:** `issued_number_unique`: Unique: document_type, value
- **Extra indexes:** `issued_numbers_type_idx`: document_type, -created_at

| `scheme_id` | uuid → numbering_schemes.id | no | — | on delete PROTECT | Person | Internal: Reference | Scheme |
| `document_type` | varchar(16) | no | — | `mrn` (Patient record number (MRN)), `encounter` (Encounter / visit number), `invoice` (Invoice number), `claim` (Insurance claim number) | Person | Internal: Business data | Document type |
| `facility_id` | uuid → facilities.id | yes | — | on delete PROTECT | Person | Internal: Reference | Facility |

## Identity: accounts, sign-in, two-factor

**Owner (source of truth):** Identity and access domain. **Design:** [ADR-011-browser-session-authentication](../../decisions/ADR-011-browser-session-authentication.md), [ADR-018-two-factor-sign-in](../../decisions/ADR-018-two-factor-sign-in.md).

A login identity within this deployment.

Register of sign-in sessions per user (HIMS-IAM-006; spec 4.4, 13.2, 13.5).

<a id="user_passkeys"></a>

| `last_used_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Last used at |

<a id="access_delegations"></a>
### `access_delegations`

Cover arrangement (spec 4.4 "delegated access"; HIMS-IAM-017): for a limited time, one person (the delegate) works with some or all of another person's access (the delegator), e.g. during leave. The access is lent as copies of the delegator's role assignments (``RoleAssignment.delegation``), so every permission rule, scope and audit applies unchanged. Never deleted; ended early with a reason, or it simply runs out.

- **Model:** `access_control.AccessDelegation`
- **Lifecycle:** Never deleted; ends by date, or early with a reason.
- **Rules:** `access_delegation_valid_period`: Check: ends_at > starts_at; `access_delegation_two_people`: Check: NOT delegator = delegate
- **Extra indexes:** `access_deleg_delegate_idx`: delegate, ends_at; `access_deleg_delegator_idx`: delegator, ends_at

<a id="support_access"></a>
### `support_access`

Supplier support access, the "locked box" (spec 7.2 "customer support access requests and approval workflow", 7.4 "emergency support access ... audit it"; HIMS-IAM-021).

- **Model:** `access_control.SupportAccess`
- **Lifecycle:** Never deleted; waiting -> given, refused or cancelled; given access ends by itself (`ends_at`) or early with a reason (HIMS-IAM-021).
- **Rules:** `support_access_hours_range`: Check: (hours ≥ 1 AND hours ≤ 24); `support_access_granted_has_period`: Check: (NOT state = 'granted' OR (starts_at is set AND ends_at > starts_at)); `support_access_one_waiting`: Unique: requested_by where state = 'waiting'
- **Extra indexes:** `support_access_state_idx`: state, -created_at; `support_access_person_idx`: requested_by, ends_at

- **Extra indexes:** `audit_occurred_idx`: occurred_at; `audit_actor_idx`: actor_id, occurred_at; `audit_resource_idx`: resource_type, resource_id, occurred_at; `audit_action_idx`: action, occurred_at

## Compliance: requirements, risks, security incidents, retention and legal holds

**Owner (source of truth):** Compliance / security officer. **Design:** [README](../../compliance/README.md).

<a id="compliance_requirements"></a>
### `compliance_requirements`

One legal or regulatory obligation and how far the hospital has met it (spec 13, 26.7; HIMS-COMP-001/002/003). Wording comes from catalog.py; status and evidence are the hospital's. Implemented in software does not mean compliant: "verified" needs written evidence.

- **Model:** `compliance.ComplianceRequirement`
- **Lifecycle:** Wording synced from code; removed items switched off, never deleted. Status changes audited.
- **Extra indexes:** `compliance_req_status_idx`: jurisdiction, status

<a id="retention_rules"></a>
### `retention_rules`

How long one kind of housekeeping record is kept before the purge deletes it (spec 4.25 "retention, legal holds ... deletion restrictions", 28.1 #5; HIMS-COMP-006). The kinds are fixed in retention.py. Empty = kept for ever, the default: nothing is deleted until the hospital sets a period. A shorter period waits (``pending_*``) before it applies.

- **Model:** `compliance.RetentionRule`
- **Lifecycle:** One per kind of purgeable record, created on migrate; never deleted. Empty period = kept for ever. Every change audited (HIMS-COMP-006).
- **Rules:** `retention_rule_pending_complete`: Check: ((pending_from is empty AND pending_keep_days is empty) OR (pending_from is set AND pending_keep_days is set))

## Notifications: emails and SMS

**Owner (source of truth):** Platform (each sending domain owns its wording). **Design:** [notifications](../../workflows/notifications.md).

<a id="notifications"></a>
### `notifications`

One email or SMS sent by HIMS (spec 4.23; HIMS-NOTIF-001), with its delivery outcome.

- **Model:** `notifications.Notification`
- **Lifecycle:** Kept as the delivery log; the real (secret-bearing) text is erased once delivered. Sent, given-up and not-sent ones purged after the period the hospital sets, unless on legal hold (HIMS-COMP-006); waiting ones never.
- **Extra indexes:** `notification_retry_idx`: status, next_attempt_at; `notification_created_idx`: created_at

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | uuid | no | uuid4() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row was created (UTC) |
| `channel` | varchar(8) | no | — | `email` (Email), `sms` (SMS) | Person | Internal: Business data | Channel |
| `category` | varchar(40) | no | — | up to 40 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | What it is about, e.g. account, security, staff, access, audit. |
| `template` | varchar(80) | no | — | up to 80 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Which message, e.g. identity.invitation (no personal data). |
| `recipients` | jsonb | no | list() | — | Person | Restricted: Contact | Email addresses or phone numbers. |
| `subject` | varchar(255) | no | — | up to 255 characters | Person | Restricted: Message (secrets hidden) | Subject |
| `body` | text | no | — | — | Person | Restricted: Message (secrets hidden) | Readable copy with sign-in links and secrets hidden. |
| `body_encrypted` | text | no | — | — | Person | Secret: Message until delivered (encrypted) | Real text until delivered. |
| `status` | varchar(10) | no | `Notification.Status.PENDING` | `pending` (Waiting to be sent), `sent` (Sent), `failed` (Failed, will retry), `gave_up` (Failed, no more retries), `skipped` (Not sent) | Person | Internal: Business data | Status |
| `attempts` | smallint | no | `0` | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Attempts |
| `next_attempt_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Next attempt at |
| `last_error` | varchar(300) | no | — | up to 300 characters | Person | Internal: System diagnostics | Last error |
| `sent_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Sent at |
| `skip_reason` | varchar(200) | no | — | up to 200 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Skip reason |
| `related_type` | varchar(40) | no | — | up to 40 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Related type |
| `related_id` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Related id |
| `requested_by_id` | uuid | yes | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Requested by id |

<a id="message_templates"></a>
### `message_templates`

A hospital's wording for one message in the catalog (HIMS-NOTIF-003). Blank means "use the standard wording" (message_catalog.py). Every change is in the audit log, before and after.

- **Model:** `notifications.MessageTemplate`
- **Lifecycle:** One row per message in the catalog; blank wording means the standard. Every change is in the audit log, before and after.

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | uuid | no | uuid4() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now (on create) | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row was created (UTC) |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now (on every save) | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row last changed (UTC) |
| `version` | integer | no | `1` | 0 or more | System | Internal: System metadata | Edit counter: a save based on an older version is refused (409) |
| `key` | varchar(80) | no | — | up to 80 characters; unique | System | Internal: Business data | Key |
| `subject` | varchar(255) | no | — | up to 255 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Subject |
| `body` | text | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Message wording (no values, no patient details) | Body |
| `updated_by_id` | uuid → users.id | yes | — | on delete PROTECT | System | Internal: Person reference (id only) | Updated by |

## Backups and restore drills

**Owner (source of truth):** Platform / operations (evidence for auditors). **Design:** [backup-and-restore](../../workflows/backup-and-restore.md).

<a id="recovery_backups"></a>
### `recovery_backups`

One backup: the database (PostgreSQL custom-format dump) and the stored documents, taken from the same moment, with a manifest describing what they contain.

- **Model:** `recovery.Backup`
- **Lifecycle:** Append-only (database trigger); one row per backup made on a developer PC. The backup files live outside the database (`HIMS_BACKUP_DIR`).

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | uuid | no | uuid4() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | When the row was created (UTC) |
| `created_by_id` | uuid | yes | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Created by id |
| `name` | varchar(80) | no | — | up to 80 characters; unique | Person | Internal: Business data | Folder name inside the backup folder. |
| `database_name` | varchar(63) | no | — | up to 63 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Database name |
| `environment` | varchar(20) | no | — | up to 20 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Environment |
| `release` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Release |
| `dump_bytes` | bigint | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Dump bytes |
| `dump_sha256` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Checksum | Dump sha256 |
| `tables` | integer | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Tables |
| `rows` | bigint | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Rows |
| `documents` | integer | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Documents |
| `documents_bytes` | bigint | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Documents bytes |
| `seconds` | double precision | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | How long the backup took. |
| `manifest` | jsonb | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Inventory: counts and fingerprints, no contents | Row counts and fingerprints per table, migrations, constraints, triggers, audit chain head and document fingerprints. No record contents. |

<a id="recovery_restore_drills"></a>
### `recovery_restore_drills`

One restore drill: a backup restored into a new, separate database and folder, every check run against the copy, then the copy removed.

- **Model:** `recovery.RestoreDrill`
- **Lifecycle:** Append-only (database trigger); one row per restore drill, the evidence that backups can be restored (spec 27.1).
- **Extra indexes:** `restore_drill_finished_idx`: finished_at

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `backup_id` | uuid → recovery_backups.id | no | — | on delete PROTECT | Person | Internal: Reference | Backup |
| `started_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Started at |
| `finished_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now() | — | System | Internal: Business data | Finished at |
| `trigger` | varchar(16) | no | — | `on_demand` (Started by a person), `command` (Started from the server command line) | Person | Internal: Business data | Trigger |
| `requested_by_id` | uuid | yes | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Requested by id |
| `outcome` | varchar(16) | no | — | `passed` (Passed: everything came back), `failed` (Failed: see the checks) | Person | Internal: Business data | Outcome |
| `restore_seconds` | double precision | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Time to restore the database and documents (evidence for the RTO). |
| `backup_age_minutes` | integer | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | How old the backup was when restored (what would be lost: evidence for the RPO). |
| `restored_database` | varchar(63) | no | — | up to 63 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Restored database |
| `checks` | jsonb | no | list() | — | Person | Internal: Check results (table names, no contents) | Checks |

## Performance checks: indexes and response times

**Owner (source of truth):** Platform / operations. **Design:** [performance-checks](../../workflows/performance-checks.md), [volume-check](volume-check.md).

<a id="performance_checks"></a>
### `performance_checks`

- **Model:** `performance.PerformanceCheck`
- **Lifecycle:** Append-only (database trigger); one row per index check or response-time measurement, kept as evidence; counts and timings only (HIMS-DATA-002, HIMS-OPS-017).
- **Extra indexes:** `performance_check_kind_idx`: kind, finished_at

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |

| `kind` | varchar(20) | no | — | `indexes` (Index check (query plans)), `response_times` (Response times) | Person | Internal: Business data | Kind |
| `started_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Started at |
| `finished_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now() | — | System | Internal: Business data | Finished at |
| `trigger` | varchar(16) | no | — | `on_demand` (Started by a person), `command` (Started from the server command line), `volume` (Volume check (throw-away copy with synthetic records)) | Person | Internal: Business data | Trigger |
| `requested_by_id` | uuid | yes | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Requested by id |
| `outcome` | varchar(16) | no | — | `passed` (Passed: every target met), `failed` (Failed: see the results) | Person | Internal: Business data | Outcome |
| `database` | varchar(63) | no | — | up to 63 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | The database measured (a volume check names its throw-away copy). |
| `environment` | varchar(20) | no | — | up to 20 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Environment |
| `release` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Release |

| `dataset_rows` | bigint | no | `0` | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Dataset rows |
| `results` | jsonb | no | list() | — | Person | Internal: Timings and index names, no record contents | One entry per query or screen: timings, index names, target, passed. No record contents. |

| `summary` | varchar(300) | no | — | up to 300 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Summary |

## Platform: transactional outbox

**Owner (source of truth):** Platform. **Design:** [ADR-005-transactional-outbox](../../decisions/ADR-005-transactional-outbox.md), [ADR-012-outbox-dispatcher](../../decisions/ADR-012-outbox-dispatcher.md).

<a id="outbox_events"></a>
### `outbox_events`

A domain event committed atomically with the change that caused it (spec 14.2, 29.7).

- **Model:** `outbox.OutboxEvent`
- **Lifecycle:** Published and dismissed rows deleted by the daily clean-up after `HIMS_OUTBOX_RETENTION_DAYS` (30); waiting and failed rows never automatically (a person sends them again or dismisses them, with a reason; HIMS-PLAT-014).
- **Extra indexes:** `outbox_published_idx`: published_at where status = 'published'; `outbox_pending_idx`: available_at, occurred_at where status = 'pending'; `outbox_aggregate_idx`: aggregate_type, aggregate_id; `outbox_attention_idx`: status, resolved_at where status in ['dead', 'dismissed']

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | uuid | no | uuid4() | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `event_type` | varchar(150) | no | — | up to 150 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Event type |
| `event_version` | smallint | no | `1` | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Event version |
| `occurred_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now() | — | System | Internal: Business data | Occurred at |
| `customer_id` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Customer id |
| `facility_id` | uuid | yes | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Facility id |
| `aggregate_type` | varchar(100) | no | — | up to 100 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Aggregate type |
| `aggregate_id` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Aggregate id |
| `correlation_id` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Correlation id |
| `causation_id` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Causation id |
| `payload` | jsonb | no | dict() | — | Person | Restricted: Event content (may hold personal data) | Payload |
| `status` | varchar(16) | no | `OutboxEvent.Status.PENDING` | `pending` (Pending), `published` (Published), `dead` (Dead (retries exhausted)), `dismissed` (Dismissed by a person (never retried)) | Person | Internal: Business data | Status |
| `attempts` | integer | no | `0` | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Attempts |
| `available_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now() | — | System | Internal: Business data | Available at |
| `published_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Published at |
| `last_error` | varchar(500) | no | — | up to 500 characters | Person | Internal: System diagnostics | Last error |
| `resolved_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Resolved at |
| `resolved_by_id` | uuid | yes | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Resolved by id |
| `resolution_note` | varchar(300) | no | — | up to 300 characters | Person | Restricted: Decision note (no patient details) | Resolution note |

<a id="outbox_processed_events"></a>
### `outbox_processed_events`

Consumer-side deduplication: one row per (handler, event) processed (spec 29.7).

- **Model:** `outbox.ProcessedEvent`
- **Lifecycle:** Kept for duplicate detection; deleted by the daily clean-up after the retention period, unless the event can still run again (HIMS-PLAT-014).
- **Rules:** `processed_event_unique`: Unique: handler, event_id
- **Extra indexes:** `outbox_processed_at_idx`: processed_at

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` **PK** | bigint | no | — | — | System | Internal: System metadata | Internal identity (random UUID; never shown as a business number) |
| `handler` | varchar(200) | no | — | up to 200 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Handler |
| `event_id` | uuid | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Event id |
| `processed_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | now (on create) | — | System | Internal: Business data | Processed at |

<a id="scheduled_jobs"></a>
### `scheduled_jobs`

The last run of each scheduled job when ``run_scheduled_jobs`` starts them (hosts without an always-on scheduler; HIMS-OPS-023). One row per job in config/schedule.py, updated on every run: a status board, not a history (failures also go to the log).

- **Model:** `outbox.ScheduledJob`
- **Lifecycle:** One row per scheduled job (config/schedule.py), updated on every run started by run_scheduled_jobs; a status board, not a history (HIMS-OPS-023).

| Column | Type | Empty allowed | Default | Allowed values | Set by | Sensitivity | Meaning |

| `task` | varchar(100) | no | — | up to 100 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Task |
| `every_seconds` | integer | no | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Every seconds |
| `last_started_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Last started at |
| `last_finished_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | — | — | System | Internal: Business data | Last finished at |
| `last_outcome` | varchar(16) | no | — | `running` (Running), `ok` (Finished), `failed` (Failed) | Person | Internal: Business data | Last outcome |
| `last_duration_ms` | integer | yes | — | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Last duration ms |
| `last_error` | varchar(300) | no | — | up to 300 characters | Person | Internal: System diagnostics, filtered like the logs | Last error |
| `runs` | integer | no | `0` | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Runs |
| `failures` | integer | no | `0` | 0 or more | Person | Internal: Business data | Failures |

## Platform: idempotency

**Owner (source of truth):** Platform. 

<a id="idempotency_records"></a>
### `idempotency_records`

Stored outcome of a write request made with an ``Idempotency-Key`` (spec 29.3).

- **Model:** `idempotency.IdempotencyRecord`
- **Lifecycle:** Purged hourly once expired (48 hours, `HIMS_IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION_HOURS`).

| `actor_id` | uuid | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Actor id |
| `operation` | varchar(100) | no | — | up to 100 characters | Person | Internal: Business data | Operation |
| `request_fingerprint` | varchar(64) | no | — | up to 64 characters | Person | Internal: Checksum | Request fingerprint |
| `response_status` | smallint | no | — | — | Person | Internal: Business data | Response status |
